positions.title: SSr. Software Engineer
description: Drove end-to-end replacement of a 6-year-old tightly coupled legacy system: extended and evolved its Go successor service, applied concurrency patterns to improve throughput, and rebuilt feature parity in React, cutting response times from ~1s to ~300–400ms. This service now orchestrates all personal data self-management flows for millions of users across 17 countries.
Owned refactoring of legacy Go services toward idiomatic patterns and cleaner dependency boundaries, making architecture decisions that improved maintainability and enabled safer long-term evolution.
Defined and enforced automated testing standards across backend services, improving long-term maintainability and reducing regression risk in production.
Extracted insights from BigQuery and built operational dashboards in Looker Studio, enabling visibility into critical KPIs and supporting data-driven decisions for engineering and product leadership.
Coordinated strategic deprecation of user-facing legacy projects, managing safe migrations and minimizing customer impact during system retirement.

positions.title: Software Developer
description: Contributed to the design and initial deployment of the Go backend API for personal data self-management.
Owned maintenance and evolution of a production React frontend, including spearheading a Node 10 to Node 14 runtime migration.
Collaborated across backend and frontend teams to support dependency upgrades, environment compliance, and production stability in business-critical systems.
